measurement_notes: Sequential fresh processes; mode order alternates by repetition. Metadata is not passed to proof search. Search/normalization/replay time excludes parsing and startup; process_wall_ms includes prover startup; peak_rss_bytes is per prover. Both modes use the same CNF limit (10000), clause cap, and wall-time budget. Python adds a 1-second hard-timeout grace.
